_doc: Lyric timeline placeholder. `bar` is on the grid in data/features.json; `t` is derived, not typed. `text` is the line that page sings, `key` the character it is about. song: placeholder grid (87.85 BPM, 4/4) — supply your own audio at input/song.wav
